jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Developer
jobs_results.description:
Hays es una de las mayores empresas de selección de personal del mundo. Estamos presentes en 32 países y contamos con 54 años de experiencia. Toda nuestra plantilla trabaja con un único objetivo: Trabajar para tu mañana.

En España, Hays está presente en 6 ciudades y trabaja en diversos sectores (IT, finanzas, ingeniería, logística...)

Nuestro cliente es una empresa proveedora de servicios de IT del sector retail, con fuerte presencia internacional expandiendo su presencia por todo el mundo. Con varias sedes, desarrollamos software flexible y soluciones de BI.

Estamos buscando para integrar al equipo un Business Inteligence Developer Data Modeling.

Tus responsabilidades serían:
• Forme parte del equipo responsable de la "Cadena de suministro de datos" interempresarial para garantizar el suministro de datos de nuevos modelos empresariales basados en datos.
• Queremos aumentar significativamente el uso y el impacto de nuestra plataforma de datos para el procesamiento en tiempo real y... por lotes dentro del grupo, ¡con su experiencia!
• Junto con tus compañeros, serás responsable del diseño y la implementación de nuestra nueva plataforma de BI robusta y de alto rendimiento en Google Cloud para datos grandes, rápidos e inteligentes. 100% solo en la nube.
• Procesar y preparar los datos a lo largo de todo su ciclo de vida en nuestros data pipelines de procesamiento de flujos de datos.
• Creación de herramientas & frameworks para el uso eficiente de la nueva plataforma de BI.
• Con una fuerte orientación al cliente, creamos la base para todas las aplicaciones de BI, una comprensión uniforme de los datos, transparencia a lo largo del procesamiento de datos y cumplimos con todos los requisitos legales y reglamentarios. Auténtico BI de autoservicio.

Requisitos:
• Nivel de inglés alto
• Conocimientos en procesos de BI y análisis de datos, transformando los datos en conocimiento para inspirar a los clientes y tienes conocimientos técnicos básicos.
• Diseño de modelos que reducen la redundancia de datos, agilizan los movimientos de datos y mejoran la gestión de la información empresarial.
• Muy buenos conocimientos de desarrollo en SQL.
• Manejo seguro de bases de datos relacionales (por ejemplo, BigQuery) y conceptos de almacenamiento de datos y modelado de datos (por ejemplo, DataVault beneficioso), así como conocimientos iniciales de tecnologías en tiempo real.
• Experiencia básica en el desarrollo de soluciones de nube escalables basadas en Google u otros proveedores de nube (por ejemplo, Terraform, Google Dataflow, etc.).
• Experiencia en el desarrollo de enfoque metódico: un diseño limpio orientado a objetos o funcional, pruebas y monitorización caracterizan su software. Los procesos limpios de construcción y despliegue son importantes para ti.
• Trabajo en equipo y buena comunicación.

Beneficios:
• Contrato indefinido
• Horario de trabajo flexible (¡tú decides cómo organizar tu día a día!)
• Modalidad de trabajo híbrida (¡trabaja desde casa hasta un 80% del tiempo, teniendo el resto para reunirte con tus compañeros en la oficina!)
• Formarás parte de una empresa en rápido crecimiento, formando parte de un gran equipo.
• Salario competitivo.
• Retribución flexible.
• Seguro médico.
• Métodos de trabajo ágiles.
• Formación y desarrollo: tenemos un claro enfoque en la innovación técnica, ¡pero no nos olvidamos del crecimiento personal!

Si consideras que tu experiencia profesional se alinea con los requisitos de este rol, no dudes en ponerte en contacto con Isabel Osés (isabel.oses@hays.es) hoy mismo para presentar su candidatura y registrar tu interés

jobs_results.title: Senior Business Intelligence Consultant
jobs_results.description:
ClearPeaks is a specialist consulting firm delivering services and solutions in "Everything Data" - Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, Big Data & Cloud, and Web & Mobile Applications. Founded in 2000, we have been a trusted partner to our customers in over 15 industry verticals and functional areas, with operations spanning Europe, Middle East, the United States, and Africa.

ClearPeaks is part of a strategic alliance with synvert, a group of six successful full-service Data & Analytics (D&A) consulting firms, with a clear goal to become one of EMEA's largest D&A consulting companies.

Our services are based on the latest market-leading enterprise technology platforms, and delivered by a dynamic team of expert consultants. Our strength lies in our ability to efficiently deliver customer insight and value, gained through our decades of experience with real-world challenges.

As a Senior BI Consultant, you will develop BI solutions to deliver the best quality projects to our... clients world-wide. At ClearPeaks, there are endless opportunities to get involved in different projects bringing innovative ideas while being part of leading-edge teams who are always innovating and evolving in the BI field.

Responsibilities
• Conduct Requirements Gathering sessions and perform gap analysis
• Design and develop DataMart’s data models and data pipelines
• Create Power BI data sets, DAX development
• Drive Testing process, define and execute test cases
• Demo solutions to executive users, collect feedback and plan implementation
• Provide training about implemented data marts to Power Users

Requirements
• Ideally Computer Science Engineering, Informatics, Statistics or other degree with interest in the business intelligence field.
• Fluent and articulate in English
• Minimum of 4 years of experience in the BI field with the ability to design and implement BI business logic and security models.
• Requirements gathering knowledge and experience, incl. wireframe prototyping
• Experience working with dimensionally modelled data such as good understand of DWH concepts
• Proven ETL experience, preferably on Informatica PowerCenter or SQL Server Integration Services.
• Customer oriented with excellent communication and presentation skills.
• Proactive, team player, committed and constant willingness to improve.
• Analytical, problem solving and creative.

Our offer to you!
• Be part of an international and talented team, enjoying an excellent work environment where people are passionate about what they do.
• Attractive salary according to experience and knowledge provided.
• Flexible working schedule

jobs_results.title: Project Manager BI
jobs_results.description:
Queremos incorporar a un/a Project Manager para unirse a nuestro equipo.

Pensamos en una persona con una experiencia mínima de 10 años gestionando proyectos IT preferentemente de BI, basados en metodologías agiles. Atenderás el pool de nuestros clientes más potentes y con mayor posibilidad de crecimiento y desarrollo, todo un reto con una trayectoria profesional que conquistar.

Tus funciones principales serán las siguientes:
• Planificación de proyectos y asignación de recursos según necesidades.
• Seguimiento de los timmings establecidos y asegurar su cumplimiento.
• Supervisión del trabajo realizado y solución de incidencias.
• Coordinación del equipo humano durante todas las fases del proyecto.
• Atención personalizada a cada miembro del equipo.
• Colaborar con el cliente y el KAM en la definición de los objetivos y evolutivos.
• Detección de errores y búsqueda de soluciones.
• Presentación de resultados e información a través de reportes visuales.
• Identificar las posibles... desviaciones, proponer y gestionar las modificaciones técnicas, económicas y temporales del plan de trabajo para la ejecución del proyecto.
• Detectar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y crecimiento orgánico, con el soporte del KAM.

Qué requerimos:
• Experiencia mínima de 10 años como Project Manager, mínimo 2 en proyectos de BI, preferentemente Microsoft (planificación, ejecución, supervisión, control y cierre de proyectos).
• Persona habituada a gestionar un equipo de personas y liderar iniciativas con varios interlocutores.
• Experiencia en análisis de datos, visión estratégica y actitud proactiva.
• Habilidades comunicativas con diferentes niveles de interlocución (cliente, equipo, KAM…)
• Nivel alto de inglés (mínimo B2).
• Experiencia en creación de consultas básicas en SQL.
• Conocimientos de soluciones de Business Intelligence.
• Experiencia en metodologías agiles (scrum, safe, etc)
• Conocimientos en herramientas de visualización y explotación de datos (muy valorable Power BI).
• Valorable certificaciones en gestión de proyectos; PMP, Prince 2, ITIL, Scrum Master…

Qué ofrecemos:
• Trabajar en Empresa líder con referentes técnicos de alto nivel, especialistas en entorno BI Microsoft.
• Formación continua tanto interna como externa.
• Buen ambiente de trabajo y posibilidad de desarrollo.
• Paquete retributivo según valores aportados.

Jornada trabajo híbrida (3 días semana teletrabajo) y flexibilidad horaria

jobs_results.description:
En serem estamos comprometidos con diversos proyectos y queremos contar con los mejores profesionales del sector.

Actualmente nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Consultor/a BI, con un mínimo de 3 año de experiencia demostrable en proyecto.

Tareas a realizar:
• Conocimientos avanzados en herramientas de explotación qlik sense
• SQL Structured Query Language, Qlik Sense, Control-M Workload Automation
• Inglés B2

Ubicación: Madrid

Modalidad de trabajo: 100% en remoto (Viajes puntuales a las oficinas del cliente)

Fomentamos un ambiente de trabajo multicultural e inclusivo, no discriminamos por edad, género o creencias; así como ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades a todo el personal.

Desarrollamos nuestras actividades bajo los principios del cuidado del medioambiente, la sostenibilidad y la responsabilidad social corporativa; colaborando en proyectos de reforestación y sostenibilidad.

Apoyamos los 10 principios del Pacto Mundial y los 17 Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible, en... materia de derechos humanos, condiciones laborales, medio ambiente y anticorrupción.

Los procesos de reclutamiento se desarrollan bajo altos estándares de calidad definiendo la incorporación en base a la experiencia y habilidades del candidato.

Somos una empresa española líder en servicios tecnológicos y atracción del talento presente en el mercado desde 1995. Contamos con más de 600 empleados en proyectos tanto nacionales como internacionales en sector TI

jobs_results.title: Analista con experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial
jobs_results.description:
NTT Data somos todas las personas que la formamos. Un equipo de más de 139.000 profesionales, tan diverso cómo diversos son los 50 países en los que estamos presentes y los diferentes sectores en los que desarrollamos nuestra actividad; telecomunicaciones, sector financiero (banca y seguros), industria, utilities, sector público y sanidad.

¿Nuestra misión? Ofrecer soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría. Todo gracias a la colaboración entre equipos, la calidad humana de nuestra gente y a que no nos conformamos con lo establecido, buscamos siempre la innovación que nos acerca al futuro.

En Valencia seguimos en proceso de crecimiento y buscamos Analistas interesados en participar en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial.

Se requiere:
• Tener la titulación del Grado en Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Matemáticas o titulaciones relacionadas.
• Especialmente valorable haber cursado... especializaciones en IA, o cursos y másteres especializados en ese sentido.
• Al menos 3-5 años de experiencia trabajando con algoritmos de inteligencia artificial y aprendizaje automático.
• Experiencia comprobada en programación, preferiblemente en Python.
• Dominio de librerías de IA y ML como TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.
• Excelentes habilidades de análisis y resolución de problemas.
• Fuertes habilidades de liderazgo y gestión de proyectos.
• Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente y trabajar en equipo.

Sus funciones se basarán en:
• Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar modelos de inteligencia artificial generativa.
• Asistir en la integración de los algoritmos de IA en procesos y casos de uso empresariales.
• Mantenerse actualizado en las últimas tendencias y tecnologías en inteligencia artificial y aprendizaje automático.
• Liderar el análisis y preprocesamiento de datos para alimentar los modelos de IA.
• Conocimiento sobre las métricas de rendimiento de modelos y el ciclo de MLOps.
• Experiencia en la implementación de modelos de aprendizaje automático en producción.
• Supervisar pruebas, validaciones y optimización de los modelos generados.
• Gestionar proyectos y coordinar con otros equipos y stakeholders.

NTT Data te ofrece:

- Contrato indefinido

- Retribución salarial acorde con la experiencia aportada

- Plan de Carrera

- Plan de Formación personalizado a nivel profesional y técnico

jobs_results.title: BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE MANAGER
jobs_results.description:
About Kosmos

Founded in Barcelona in 2017, KOSMOS is a Barcelona based holding company, founded and chaired by professional football player Gerard Piqué, and backed by Hiroshi Mikitani, the Chairman and CEO of Rakuten. At KOSMOS we are passionate about building a global portfolio of high-quality sports, media, and entertainment companies. With a particular focus on sports and exclusive access, we are capitalizing on and shaping this quickly growing landscape.

At KOSMOS, we’re always dreaming about going further. We are constantly pushing ourselves to innovate and create new things.

The Kings & Queens Leagues are exciting competitions that seamlessly merge sport and entertainment in a very creative way. With renowned content creators as club presidents, we propose to play sports with new and disruptive rules, all streamed live on social media.

About The Role

As a Business Intelligence Manager at KOSMOS, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable... insights that drive strategic decision-making. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the Business Intelligence (BI) team, collaborating with cross-functional departments, and implementing effective BI solutions to enhance the company's performance and competitive edge in the sports industry.

Main Responsibilities:
• Data Strategy and Governance:
• Develop and implement a comprehensive data strategy aligned with business objectives.
• Establish and enforce data governance policies, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and security.
• BI Solution Development:
• Design and implement scalable and efficient BI solutions to extract insights from structured and unstructured data sources.
• Utilize cutting-edge BI tools and technologies to create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that facilitate decision-making processes.
• Stakeholder Collaboration:
• Collaborate with key stakeholders across departments to understand their analytical needs and provide insights that drive business outcomes.
• Act as a liaison between the BI team and other business units to ensure alignment and understanding of data-related initiatives.
• Performance Monitoring and Optimization:
• Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and monitor the company's performance against these metrics.
• Continuously optimize BI processes to enhance efficiency and relevance of insights provided to decision-makers.
• Training and Development:
• Provide training sessions and resources to empower end-users to leverage BI tools effectively.
• Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, incorporating relevant advancements into the BI strategy.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
• You have demonstrated at least 8 to 10 years of experience in data analytics and/or BI.
• Advanced level of written and spoken English.
• Proficiency in BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent.
• Strong understanding of data warehousing, ETL processes, and data modelling.
• Excellent leadership, communication, influence and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to translate complex data concepts into business insights for non-technical stakeholders.
• Knowledge of sports industry trends and dynamics.
• Proven experience in a managerial role within Business Intelligence or Analytics.
• Experience with advanced analytics, machine learning, or predictive modelling.
• Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

About Kosmos

Founded in Barcelona in 2017, KOSMOS is a Barcelona based holding company, founded and chaired by professional football player Gerard Piqué, and backed by Hiroshi Mikitani, the Chairman and CEO of Rakuten. At KOSMOS we are passionate about building a global portfolio of high-quality sports, media, and entertainment companies. With a particular focus on sports and exclusive access, we are capitalizing on and shaping this quickly growing landscape.

At KOSMOS, we’re always dreaming about going further. We are constantly pushing ourselves to innovate and create new things.

The Kings & Queens Leagues are exciting competitions that seamlessly merge sport and entertainment in a very creative way. With renowned content creators as club presidents, we propose to play sports with new and disruptive rules, all streamed live on social media.

About The Role

As a Business Intelligence Manager at KOSMOS, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable... insights that drive strategic decision-making. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the Business Intelligence (BI) team, collaborating with cross-functional departments, and implementing effective BI solutions to enhance the company's performance and competitive edge in the sports industry.

Main Responsibilities:
• Data Strategy and Governance:
• Develop and implement a comprehensive data strategy aligned with business objectives.
• Establish and enforce data governance policies, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and security.
• BI Solution Development:
• Design and implement scalable and efficient BI solutions to extract insights from structured and unstructured data sources.
• Utilize cutting-edge BI tools and technologies to create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that facilitate decision-making processes.
• Stakeholder Collaboration:
• Collaborate with key stakeholders across departments to understand their analytical needs and provide insights that drive business outcomes.
• Act as a liaison between the BI team and other business units to ensure alignment and understanding of data-related initiatives.
• Performance Monitoring and Optimization:
• Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and monitor the company's performance against these metrics.
• Continuously optimize BI processes to enhance efficiency and relevance of insights provided to decision-makers.
• Training and Development:
• Provide training sessions and resources to empower end-users to leverage BI tools effectively.
• Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, incorporating relevant advancements into the BI strategy.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
• You have demonstrated at least 8 to 10 years of experience in data analytics and/or BI.
• Advanced level of written and spoken English.
• Proficiency in BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent.
• Strong understanding of data warehousing, ETL processes, and data modelling.
• Excellent leadership, communication, influence and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to translate complex data concepts into business insights for non-technical stakeholders.
• Knowledge of sports industry trends and dynamics.
• Proven experience in a managerial role within Business Intelligence or Analytics.
• Experience with advanced analytics, machine learning, or predictive modelling.
• Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

OUR PROPOSITION
• Competitive base salary
• Flexible working hours
• Flexible compensation plan
• A diverse and inclusive working environment
• Equal employment opportunity for everyone.

jobs_results.title: EMEA Claims Operations Business Intelligence Lead
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

If working with one of the largest commercial insurers in the world appeals, then we would love to hear from you!

EMEA Claims Operations MI/BI team (Management Information & Business Intelligence) is required to provide deep data insights to COG, regional EMEA Leadership & local claims clusters/countries heads and SLT.

This ranges from typical claims trend analytics with already defined KPI’s, trend developments over time, up to sophisticated predictive trend forecast & staffing models with respective management recommendations.

This position is responsible for assisting in leading the data, reporting and analytics strategy in EMEA Claims Operations. In this capacity, you will work closely with EMEA business unit leaders to support the MI/BI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
• The EMEA Claims Operations Business Intelligence Lead will be assisting in the development of the data strategy for EMEA claims and associated strategic projects and data reporting.
•... Establish a strong understanding & connection with IT data sources where needed to generate, validate & discuss data sources and validity.
• Communicating & building sustainable relationships with Claims Handlers, IT, Data and actuarial department as well as other key internal departments in Chubb EMEA.
• The EMEA Claims Operations Business Intelligence Lead will assist in the oversight, automation and development of dashboards, reports and trending analysis.
• Deliver statistical analysis to identify performance development opportunities and build cases for change.
• Strong focus on Chubb’s Claims Craftmanship modules & MI/BI relevant training on all Chubb systems, data manipulation & digital innovations.
• Actively drive self-studies to assure to be up to date & assure sustainable knowledge bench-strength.
• To work within the framework of CHUBB ethical and service standards and adhere to current WFH local regulations.
• Demonstrate flexibility, agile attitude, team cooperation, lean & 6Sigma mindset and long-term business thinking.

Requirements & Experience
• SQL, statistical modelling software e.g. R, Python, Excel (advanced), Qlik Sense, Access, Cognos
• Strong verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency in translating detailed reporting outputs, trends, and statistics into executive-level reporting and presentations: distil complex analytical techniques and results into actionable insights and articulate their implications for business decisions and outcomes.
• Exposure to using operational MI to supervise and achieve business targets / objectives and the ability to prove their contribution has improved the performance of the business.
• Excellent project management lead and organisation skills. Experience managing technical staff preferred.
• proven experience in an analytics driven role. Experience in building statistics and business insight to optimise business decisions.
• Strong sense of execution & accountability with ability of explain complex matters in a simple way with the main stakeholder. Such as internal stakeholder RCCM’s, Claims Director’s, LOB heads and SME’s in the respective areas.
• Very strong analytical thinking on a regional level is required and being able to drive conclusions in anticipating future trends and develop relevant hypotheses to be verified or falsified using the best data insights.
• A sense of entrepreneurial mentality is encouraged, with the ability to lead meetings with tight data delivery deadlines and under pressure.
• Very Strong communication skills and again outstanding ability to explain complex fundamentals in simple terms. At least 5 years plus relevant work experience in Insurance or equivalent industry.
• University degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration or Mathematical/Statistics science preferred or equivalent qualifications in an international environment of a global corporation or consulting.
• * Fluent in English and one/two other relevant local languages preferred. English (must), German, French, Spanish,... is recommended.ADKAR

We offer in return!
• Competitive salary & pension scheme, annual bonus scheme, 25 days annual leave plus ability to purchase 5 additional days, Private Medical cover, Employee Share Purchase Plan, Life Assurance, Subsidised gym membership, Comprehensive Learning & development offerings.
• Employee resource groups, Networking, mentoring & development opportunities, 1 day annual Charitable leave, Cycle to work scheme, Active Sports & social committee, Employee Assistance program

Integrity. Client focus. Respect. Excellence. Teamwork

Our core values dictate how we live and work. We’re an ethical and honest company that’s wholly committed to its clients. A business that’s engaged in mutual trust and respect for its employees and partners. A place where colleagues perform at the highest levels. And a working environment that’s collaborative and supportive.

Diversity & Inclusion. At Chubb we consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness and respect, regardless of their age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status or family circumstances.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation

jobs_results.title: Especialista hubgrade - gestión de datos
jobs_results.description:
Descripción de la empresa

El grupo Veolia tiene la ambición de volverse la empresa de referencia de la transformación ecológica. Presente en los cinco continentes con cerca de 179 000 empleados, el Grupo diseña e implementa soluciones útiles y concretas para la gestión de agua, residuos y energía que ayudan a cambiar radicalmente el panorama. Con sus tres actividades complementarias, Veolia contribuye al desarrollo del acceso a los recursos así como a la preservación y renovación de los recursos disponibles. En 2020, el grupo Veolia abasteció de agua potable a 95 millones de personas y prestó servicio de saneamiento a 62 millones, produjo cerca de 43 millones de MWh y valorizó 47 millones de toneladas de residuos.

Veolia Latam-Iberia está especializada en la gestión integral de Agua y Residuos y energía para clientes municipales e industriales de toda América Latina, España y Portugal. Actualmente está presente en 11 países (Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, México... Panamá, Perú, Uruguay, Portugal y España).

Veolia en México consolida su presencia y liderazgo local con soluciones medio ambientales de agua, residuos y energía para municipios e industrias.

Nuestra misión es generar valor para nuestros clientes ofreciendo las soluciones más completas en la gestión integral de agua, residuos y energía para contribuir a la mejora de la calidad de vida de las personas y al cuidado del ambiente.

La empresa gestiona anualmente en el país 2.3 millones de toneladas de Residuos Sólidos en tratamiento y 800 mil en recolección y potabiliza aproximadamente 500MMm3 de agua, alcanzando más de 20 ciudades atendidas y 13 millones de usuarios en sus dos actividades.

En cuanto al sector industrial, Veolia México garantiza un servicio responsable y eficiente en el tratamiento y disposición final de residuos sólidos y residuos peligrosos.

Muestra de ello son los más de 7,000 clientes satisfechos en México y América latina, con los que estamos comprometidos, dando servicio a grandes corporaciones multinacionales como a empresas locales

Descripción del empleo

Solicitamos:

Especialista Hubgrade - Gestión de datos

Roles & Responsabilidades:

Realizar la construcción de procesos ETLs (Extraer, Transformar y Cargar), bases de datos y manejo SQL para los diferentes proyectos del área

Procesar los datos usando diferentes métodos estadísticos, para el análisis de datos históricos para detectar oportunidades de mejora y eficiencias en los sitios así como en su entorno

Implementar herramientas de inteligencia de negocios (Business Intelligence) para analizar información, mediante el seguimiento de KPI´S

Transferir conocimientos con los sitios para mantener operativos los procesos ya implementados

Requisitos

Perfil académico : Lic en sistemas, Ing Civil, hidráulica o afín. Al no contar con esta educación se considerará la experiencia laboral y cargos anteriores respecto a los conocimientos académicos que se requieren y la experiencia práctica adquirida.

Conocimientos básicos de eléctrica, mecánica, instrumentación, control, manejo de datos, operación de PTAR, ETAP, plantas, etc.

Experiencia:

· 2 años como especialista en cuartos de control y sistemas de monitoreo, operación y/o mantenimiento de PTARs.
· Desarrollo de paneles de seguimiento.

Competencias duras:

· Uso de aplicaciones para monitoreo de las operaciones con sistema SCADA
· Manejo de equipo de cómputo y conocimiento de las principales herramientas informáticas
· Manejo y desarrollo de ambientes business intelligence
• Posición con base en Ciudad de México
• Disponibilidad de viajar

Información adicional

As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination

jobs_results.description:
ABOUT US

Leica Geosystems, part of Hexagon, is a global organization supporting measurement professionals

worldwide. With Head Quarters in Switzerland, Leica Geosystems boasts 200 years’ experience in

offering products for surveying and geographical measurement as a global market leader for geodetic instruments, sensors, software, and autonomous solutions and has approximately 21k employees in 50 countries.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The role is part of our department Global Business Support (GBS). Reporting to the Team leader

BI/BW Support Team, the main mission is to build a Process Excellence Support Organisation to grant best practices in our processes and the most efficient and effective utilisation of provided IT tools byour local Sales- and Customer Care Teams.

Main responsibilities:

• being the link between local key users and the IT or other headquarter functions in Switzerland.

• On-site or remote incident support, conducting key-user training as refresher or to new employees... or providing initial Know-How to new local entities will be core activities.

• Recommendations for process or organisational changes, tool innovations and the support during implementation by reviewing specifications and ensuring effective key-user tests will be additional activities to support continuous innovation.

• providing high level expertise to the local key users in executing the processes and using the provided tools smartly and with attention

• administrate users and authorizations

QUALIFICATIONS /EXPERIENCE

• Proactive and dynamic professional, with high service orientation in solving problems and preventing them for the future

• Team worker with excellent communicative skills and ability to convey knowledge using state-of-the-art IT tools

• University Degree in Applied Sciences, Engineering, IT, Business Administration or a comparable onthe job development in the below specified expertise areas

• Experience in Data Warehouse ideally SAP BW

• Experience with SAP BI tools (Analysis for Office or Web integrated)

• SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) experience is an advantage

• Experiences in the sales fulfillment and supply chain process controlled with SAP R/3 SD and MM

modules- having had the role of a key-user will be valued.

• Knowledge of Query Designer, DesignStudio or Integrated Planning (BW-IP) is an advantage

• Good level of English; any other languages will be valued.

• Availability to travel, especially in Europe (this role up to 20%)

COMPANY BENEFITS
• Competitive remuneration package: fixed part + bonus paid 2 times a year in March and September. The bonus is calculated according to the company's performance.
• Stable employment conditions: permanent contract
• Ticket Restaurants (2420 euro net by year)
• Life insurance paid for by the company
• Possibility to apply at any time for private medical insurance with Adeslas
• Modern office in an attractive location in Barcelona (5 minutes walking from Sants Train Station)
• Friendly and international working environment with collaborative spirit. We have employees with +33 different nationalities in our Barcelona office!
• Access to an online platform reserved for our employees where you can benefit from discounts on more than 50 brands including fashion, technology, travel, culture, etc.
• Remote work policy: the company provides 250 euro per year gross to manage internet and other expenses.
• Teleworking model: hybrid model with a lot of flexibility
• Flexible benefits in transport, education, kindergarten

jobs_results.title: BI Engineer
jobs_results.description:
⦿ BI Engineer @BlueThrone ⦿This role is not just a job; it's a calling for those who dare to lead, inspire, and transform the digital landscape. Join us, and let's chart the course to a future written in the stars of success.
🌍 Remote, 100% Work-From-Anywhere 🌍About BlueThrone

Embark on a transformative journey with BlueThrone, a pioneer in the mobile app domain. We specialise in turning promising B2B mobile apps into market leaders, boasting over 49.5 million organic downloads and 4.6 million monthly active users.

With a mission to propel iOS and Android applications to new heights, we've achieved a remarkable ARR organically in just 25 months, exemplifying sustainable growth and innovation. Our team, rich in tech entrepreneurship and mobile marketing expertise, thrives in an environment that values agility, growth mindset, flexibility, creativity, and tangible outcomes.

The Opportunity

BlueThrone is seeking its first Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer to lay the foundation... for our data-driven decision-making process. Reporting directly to the CTO and working closely with the CEO and senior leadership, this role offers the unique opportunity to shape the BI landscape of our rapidly growing company. As a pivotal member of our team, you will harness the power of data to illuminate insights that drive our strategic direction, optimize performance, and unveil new opportunities for growth.
Key Responsibilities

Your Mission
• Analyze and Understand Data: Dive deep into complex data sets to unveil insights that inform business decisions across all levels of the organization.
• Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work directly with the CEO, CTO, and senior leadership to understand data needs, delivering actionable insights that drive strategic initiatives.
• Build Dashboards and Presentations: Design and develop intuitive dashboards and presentations that communicate key metrics and insights to stakeholders, facilitating data-driven decision-making.
• Create and Manage Documentation: Establish and maintain a comprehensive data catalog and documentation, ensuring clarity and accessibility of data insights across the organization.
• Data Modeling: Develop and refine data models that accurately represent business processes, enabling efficient analysis and reporting.
• Communicate Complex Data to Non-Technical Stakeholders: Effectively translate complex data findings into understandable insights for various roles across the organization, ensuring clarity and actionable intelligence for all.

Your Expedition Toolkit
• Proficient in SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
• Experience with cloud-based data warehouses such as BigQuery or AWS Athena.
• Proficient in using BI tools like Metabase, Tableau, or Apache Superset for creating compelling visualizations.
• Solid understanding of data visualization principles and best practices for dashboard design.
• Strong foundation in data analytics, including statistical analysis and the ability to present findings clearly and compellingly.
• Familiarity with data modeling techniques and best practices.
• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
• Fluent in English, proficiency in Hebrew and/or Russian is a plus.

Nice to Have
• Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation.
• Experience with Jupyter Notebook or Google Collab for collaborative data exploration and analysis.

Why Join BlueThrone?

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

⦿ BI Engineer @BlueThrone ⦿This role is not just a job; it's a calling for those who dare to lead, inspire, and transform the digital landscape. Join us, and let's chart the course to a future written in the stars of success.
🌍 Remote, 100% Work-From-Anywhere 🌍About BlueThrone

Embark on a transformative journey with BlueThrone, a pioneer in the mobile app domain. We specialise in turning promising B2B mobile apps into market leaders, boasting over 49.5 million organic downloads and 4.6 million monthly active users.

With a mission to propel iOS and Android applications to new heights, we've achieved a remarkable ARR organically in just 25 months, exemplifying sustainable growth and innovation. Our team, rich in tech entrepreneurship and mobile marketing expertise, thrives in an environment that values agility, growth mindset, flexibility, creativity, and tangible outcomes.

The Opportunity

BlueThrone is seeking its first Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer to lay the foundation... for our data-driven decision-making process. Reporting directly to the CTO and working closely with the CEO and senior leadership, this role offers the unique opportunity to shape the BI landscape of our rapidly growing company. As a pivotal member of our team, you will harness the power of data to illuminate insights that drive our strategic direction, optimize performance, and unveil new opportunities for growth.
Key Responsibilities

Your Mission
• Analyze and Understand Data: Dive deep into complex data sets to unveil insights that inform business decisions across all levels of the organization.
• Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work directly with the CEO, CTO, and senior leadership to understand data needs, delivering actionable insights that drive strategic initiatives.
• Build Dashboards and Presentations: Design and develop intuitive dashboards and presentations that communicate key metrics and insights to stakeholders, facilitating data-driven decision-making.
• Create and Manage Documentation: Establish and maintain a comprehensive data catalog and documentation, ensuring clarity and accessibility of data insights across the organization.
• Data Modeling: Develop and refine data models that accurately represent business processes, enabling efficient analysis and reporting.
• Communicate Complex Data to Non-Technical Stakeholders: Effectively translate complex data findings into understandable insights for various roles across the organization, ensuring clarity and actionable intelligence for all.

Your Expedition Toolkit
• Proficient in SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
• Experience with cloud-based data warehouses such as BigQuery or AWS Athena.
• Proficient in using BI tools like Metabase, Tableau, or Apache Superset for creating compelling visualizations.
• Solid understanding of data visualization principles and best practices for dashboard design.
• Strong foundation in data analytics, including statistical analysis and the ability to present findings clearly and compellingly.
• Familiarity with data modeling techniques and best practices.
• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
• Fluent in English, proficiency in Hebrew and/or Russian is a plus.

Nice to Have
• Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation.
• Experience with Jupyter Notebook or Google Collab for collaborative data exploration and analysis.

Why Join BlueThrone?

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

🌍 Global Reach: Work with a diverse team of 50 exceptional talents spread across over 19 countries, expanding your professional network and cultural understanding.
